⚡ The new PM's flagship policy: £45 a year off your electricity bill. From October.

The bill itself? Up around £221 this month, as Ofgem's price cap jumped 13%. The £850m VAT gesture doesn't touch a single levy, carbon cost or subsidy loaded onto British bills - it just refunds a sliver of them, with a Downing Street note attached.

Cut the cause, not the commission: strip the levies, use Britain's own energy, and bills stop rising for good.
